title: Straighten Viscous Rectified Flow via Noise Optimization
tldr_zh: 编码器把真实图像映成 (μ,σ²) 重参数化噪声、与真实图像直接配对训练，加历史速度项；CIFAR-10 一步 FID 4.50，但采样也需输入数据集图像
tldr_en: VRFNO pairs real images with encoder-reparameterized noise (VAE-style, KL-regularized) plus a historical-velocity input; one-step CIFAR-10 FID 4.50, yet sampling also consumes dataset images.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 one-step FID 4.50 / KID 2.73e-3 / IS 9.59 in Table 1 (text says 4.53 / 10.59); vs CAF 4.81, TraFlow 4.50, Shortcut 4.93
Ablation 1 NFE: baseline 379 -> HVT only 332 -> noise optimization only 4.72 -> both 4.53 (Table 3)
NFSS straightness on CIFAR-10: 2-RF 0.058, CAF 0.035, VRFNO 0.026 (Table 4)
Thm 1: crossing probability of random linear interpolants is O(exp(-c n^2))
Inference 512 images, 1 NFE: RF 0.172s, CAF 0.181s, VRFNO 0.305s (Table 5)
